items.problem: Legacy Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs copied from the UWP project causes CS0579 duplicate-assembly-attribute build failures (and CS0246 unresolved attribute types) because SDK-style WinUI 3 projects auto-generate those attributes.
items.evidence: session-log.txt:3172-3177 (CS0579 Duplicate AssemblyCompany/Configuration/FileVersion/Product/Title/Version in AppServices.AssemblyInfo.cs); :3388-3393 (CS0246 AssemblyDescriptionAttribute etc. in RandomNumberService\Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs); resolved turns 38-41 over 2 extra build cycles.
items.skill_search: grepped winui-uwp-migration for 'AssemblyInfo', 'GenerateAssemblyInfo', 'CS0579', 'Duplicate' — no matches anywhere in SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, or scripts.
items.root_cause: Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 copies all .cs files including Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs; the SDK-style project also emits GenerateAssemblyInfo attributes → duplicate definitions.
items.proposed_fix: Tier 1: in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1, empty any copied AssemblyInfo.cs that declares assembly attributes. Tier 3: add a CS0579 subsection to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md 'Common build errors' documenting empty-the-file / GenerateAssemblyInfo=false.
items.generalizes: Every classic/UWP project carries a Properties\AssemblyInfo.cs; every WinUI 3 scaffold is SDK-style with auto-generated assembly info. This CS0579 collision recurs in essentially all UWP->WinUI 3 migrations, independent of scenario.
